summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Espiritudos (Fortnite Spirits marketplace) on the public preview URL. Covered: home/logo/country selector, country switching + price updates, catalog with 10 spirits and all 6 rarity filters, +/- cart controls and floating footer, CartSummary with 5%/10%/15% quantity discounts, UserForm validation + country-specific payment methods, OrderConfirmation, html2canvas image generation, image download, NextSteps (9 steps), ThankYou social links, start-over reset, and the reviews carousel (5 slides + indicators). Core 6-step purchase flow works end-to-end. Two functional bugs found: (1) cart is completely lost when using 'Volver al catálogo', (2) APP_CONFIG.defaultCountry ('PE') is ignored - auto-detection resolves to 'US' in this environment so the app opens with Estados Unidos / $0.10 instead of Perú / S/0.30. Plus cosmetic issues in the generated image and Spanish/English mixing.

ui_bugs.issue: Cart data loss: quantities live in SpiritsCatalog local state; clicking 'Volver al catálogo' (back-to-catalog) unmounts/remounts the catalog and all selected quantities reset to 0 (quantity badges gone, footer bar disappears). User must re-select everything. Verified twice. Cart state must be lifted to App.js (selectedSpirits) and passed back into SpiritsCatalog as initial state.

window.APP_CONFIG.defaultCountry ('PE') is never used. detectCountry() falls through to the navigator.language 'en' branch and selects US, so the app loads as 'Estados Unidos' with $0.10/spirit instead of Perú S/0.30 (requirement says Perú should be the default). Header confirmed showing 'Estados Unidos'.

Gradient text does not render in the generated PNG: html2canvas ignores -webkit-background-clip:text/WebkitTextFillColor:transparent, so the 'Espiritudos' title and the 'TOTAL: S/x.xx' value are painted as white text on top of a solid purple->pink->cyan gradient rectangle in the downloaded order image. Use solid color text for elements captured by html2canvas.

Rarity is rendered as the raw English enum value ('Legendary', 'Epic', 'Rare'...) via capitalize, while the app is Spanish-only. Should map to Legendario/Épico/Raro/Poco Común/Común as done in SpiritsCatalog.
Stepper displays numbers 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 to the user (step 2 skipped) which looks like a broken flow. Also the unused onCountryChange prop is passed to Header (dead code).
Pluralization: shows '1 Spirits' when only one item is selected.

issues: Fixed bottom bar is cramped: 'Total de items / 1 Spirits' wraps onto 3 lines and nearly collides with the 'Continuar al Resumen' button (button box 273x88 starting at x=100). Consider stacking or shrinking on small screens.
Grid has only mb-8 bottom margin, so the fixed bar overlays the bottom of the last card row; add bottom padding when the bar is visible.

Spirit images are generic Unsplash stock photos (crystals, a game controller, abstract blue blobs) that have nothing to do with Fortnite Spirits - low relevance to the app description. Review images are also generic stock photos rather than customer review screenshots.
Social links are still placeholders (discord.gg/yourserver, wa.me/51999999999, facebook.com/yourpage) and are also printed inside the generated order image.

action_items: Lift cart quantities to App.js so the cart survives 'Volver al catálogo' navigation (HIGH).
Honor window.APP_CONFIG.defaultCountry as the fallback in detectCountry() so Perú is the default when detection is inconclusive (HIGH).
Replace gradient-clipped text with solid colors inside the html2canvas capture container so the generated PNG shows the title and TOTAL correctly.
Translate rarity labels in CartSummary (share a single rarity label map across components).
Fix stepper numbering (1..5) and '1 Spirits' pluralization; add bottom padding for the fixed cart bar on mobile.
Replace stock Unsplash spirit/review images and placeholder social URLs with real assets.
critical_code_review_comments: Cart state duplication: discount/subtotal/total math is copy-pasted in CartSummary, OrderConfirmation and ImageGenerator (>20 lines each). Extract a useOrderTotals(selectedSpirits, country) hook to avoid divergence.

ImageGenerator useEffect has an empty dep array while using onImageGenerated/props, and on html2canvas failure it only console.errors - the user is stuck forever on the 'Generando tu Imagen...' spinner with no retry/error UI. Add an error state + retry.
The rarity list is duplicated in SpiritsCatalog; move it into public/js/config.js (or a shared module) so labels/colors are configured in one place as the requirement states.
seed_data_creation: None (static JS config data). Test order used name 'QA Tester', Epic ID 'QATester123'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No backend. Spirit ids are 'legendary-1','legendary-2','epic-1','epic-2','rare-1','rare-2','uncommon-1','uncommon-2','common-1','common-2' (NOT spirit_1). Working testids: country-XX, filter-{all|legendary|epic|rare|uncommon|common}, increase-/decrease-{spiritId}, continue-to-summary, cart-total, back-to-catalog, continue-to-form, input-name/-epic-id/-discord/-whatsapp/-date/-time/-comments, payment-{yape|plin|paypal|binance|usdt|bizum}, submit-form, generate-image-btn, generated-image, download-image-btn, next-step-1..9, finish-btn, social-discord/-whatsapp/-facebook, start-over-btn, review-{id}, review-prev/next, review-indicator-0..4. Verified working: filters (2 per rarity, 10 total), discounts 5%/10%/15% math, form validation (5 required-field errors), html2canvas generation (~760KB dataURL, 2400px wide), download (fortnite-spirits-pedido-*.png), thank-you + start-over reset, carousel prev/next/indicators with correct disabled states. Note the container auto-detects US, so click country-PE first if you need S/ pricing.
rca_of_the_issue: Cart loss: SpiritsCatalog owns `quantities` in useState and App.js renders it only for currentStep===1; going back re-mounts the component with an empty object, and App's selectedSpirits is never fed back in. Default country: detectCountry() sets a local countryCode='PE' but the if/else chain reaches `language.startsWith('en')` (container locale en-US) and overrides it with 'US'; APP_CONFIG.defaultCountry is never read.
